[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Majority Element II** [LC 229 · Majority Element II](https://leetcode.com/problems/majority-element-ii/){difficulty="Medium"}

More than $n/3$ admits **two** winners, so two counters — and the general rule: threshold $n/(k{+}1)$ needs $k$ counters, because the deletion batch is now "$k{+}1$ mutually distinct elements", each batch taking at most one copy from any value that clears the bar (@sec-hash-vote). One more thing changes: nothing promises that a winner exists. Every value above $n/3$ is guaranteed to end in a seat, but a seat may also hold a value that never reached the threshold — on $[1, 2, 3]$ the seats end holding $1$ and $2$, and neither occurs more than once. So the verification pass is part of the algorithm, not a courtesy: it removes the impostors.

[Solved in full in @sec-hash-p4-b.]{.card-link}

:::
